item.title: Core Keeper Fishing Guide — Best Spots, Bait, the Fishing Workbench and Rare Fish
item.description: Fishing in Core Keeper is more than a side activity: it is a second ore income, a key source of accessories, and the only way to summon Omoroth later. This advanced Core Keeper fishing guide explains how the catch system decides what you pull out, how to set up a fishing corner, and which water to stand in for the rare fish and valuables you actually want.
